claude-opus-5-5.title: M.A.D Kizomba FLOW – Raizes AfroVibes 2026
claude-opus-5-5.description:
🎉 M.A.D Kizomba FLOW – Raízes • Afro Vibes 🎉
🇫🇷 A weekend full of vibes, connection, and energy 🇫🇷
📅 Saturday, November 7 – Monday, November 9, 2026
📍 Tiny Dance – Genas
25 rue André Citroën, 69740 GENAS
⸻
🔥 Get ready for a unique experience…
Blending Kizomba, Afro Konpa, connection, and pure energy, immerse yourself in a world where dance becomes emotion.
⸻
💃 PROGRAM
✨ Lady Styling & Konpa
🌀 Tarraxo
🌊 Sensual Kizomba & Slow Motion
🌍 Urban Kizomba
🔥 Afro vibes & much more…
👉 Classes designed to elevate you, help you progress, and let you feel every movement.
⸻
❄️✨ INSTRUCTOR LINE-UP
🔥 Curtis Seldon – Urban Kizomba
🔥 Auguste Gouriou – Kizomba Slow Motion
🔥 Séverine – Kompa
🔥 Erwan & Clémence – Urban Kizomba
🔥 Sanka N’Gage – Afro House
⸻
🎧 INTERNATIONAL DJs
🔥 DJ Lenhy Bushido
🔥 DJ Geero Beatz
🔥 Deejay Elson
🔥 DJ Naty
🔥 DJ Lys
👉 One mission: to keep the energy high all night long 🔥
GUESTS:
✨ TEACHER / AFRI : Semba Konpa
✨ TEACHER / Gloire : Kizomba
✨ DEEJAY / DJ LCSLOW
✨ …
⸻
🎟️ RESERVATIONS
https://my.weezevent.com/mad-kizomba-flow-r-a-i-z-e-s-a-f…
💶 Presale tickets available now
⚠️ Limited spots (classes + parties)
❌💳 Credit/debit cards not accepted on-site.
💰 Cash payment only. ⸻
👜 PRACTICAL INFO
Coat check: €2 (cash)
🚗 Private parking
🚌 Carpooling available
✈️ 15 mins from Lyon Airport
⸻
🏨 PARTNER ACCOMMODATION
✨ Hotel Parkest (4⭐) – less than 3 minutes away
💶 ~€74 to €90
⸻
🔐 OTHER NEARBY OPTIONS
✨ Kyriad Lyon Est – Genas Eurexpo (~€43–€49)
✨ Appart Hôtel Coraline (~€70–€80)
✨ Mercure Lyon Genas Eurexpo (~€72–€92)
✨ Le Loft de Genas (~€105–€114)
⸻
📲 INFO & CONTACT
📞 06 77 36 04 66
📧 night.one.l.pro@gmail.com
📸 Instagram: @mad_nightonelove
⸻
🔥 So… who’s coming?
Come feel the vibe, learn, connect, and have a blast with us.
⚡ M.A.D Kizomba FLOW – more than just an event… an experience.
